sources.snippet: This project uses GPT2 model from KerasNLP library as the base language model and fine-tune the GPT2 on Stanford Alpaca dataset from alpaca-lora repository. NOTE: The Alpaca dataset used in this project is the enhanced version of the original Standford Alpaca dataset by open source communities to fix some flaws manually and with GPT4 API.
